review.tagline: LLM tracing, evals, gateway and governance platform for agents and coding assistants
review.summary: LangWatch traces LLM calls and runs agent simulation tests, evaluations and prompt management. It also includes an OpenAI and Anthropic compatible gateway with virtual keys and budgets, plus tracking for coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex. Self-hosting starts with `npx @langwatch/server`, which needs only Node.js.
review.audience: Teams running LLM agents in production who need tracing, evals and spend control
strengths: Integrates with LangChain, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, DSPy and OpenTelemetry
Tracks coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, opencode) with cost per pull request
Gateway offers virtual keys with budgets and one OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoint
Self-host quickstart needs only Node.js; SDKs for Python and TypeScript
weaknesses: Enterprise modules under enterprise/ need a commercial license in production
Broad scope (ops, gateway, governance) makes it heavier than a tracing-only tool
README gives no RAM, database or port requirements for production self-hosting
No Docker or compose file detected in the repository
needs: Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, Bedrock
